stimuli.purpose: Locate the full-versus-partial boundary around the exact normal-quality-and-pace criterion under neutral keys.
stimuli.question: Which description best represents the person's current ability to complete essential work?
stimuli.instructionSuffix: Treat choice names as identifiers. Base the answer on the descriptions.

states.d0_explicit_normal: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance.
states.d1_normal_but_untested_day: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace. I have not yet tested the phone workflow for a full day.
states.d2_one_duty_may_be_slower: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. Most duties are at normal pace; I am unsure whether one duty may take slightly longer.
states.d3_roughly_normal_pace: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and roughly normal pace without assistance.
states.d4_close_to_normal_pace: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. The pace feels close to normal, although the phone is less convenient.

descriptions.full: The person can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance.
descriptions.partial: The person can complete some essential job duties, but at least one essential duty cannot be completed at normal quality or pace.
descriptions.none: The person cannot complete any essential job duty.

randomization.unit: complete balanced block containing every calibration state once

selectionRule.metric: absolute distance between mean P(partial)+P(none) and 0.50
